|game_text=If [[Death Star]] orbits [[Alderaan]] (and [Virtual Block 7] [[Death Star: Central Core (V){{!}}Central Core]] on table), deploy on Death Star and fire [[Superlaser]] at Alderaan; it is 'blown away.' Once during your control phase, if Death Star orbiting a planet (except a Rebel Base) without related sites, may fire Superlaser at planet (regardless of Objective restrictions) as follows: Draw destiny. Add 2 if you control that system. If (destiny + Y - Z) > 8, target is 'blown away' and opponent loses 4 Force from Life Force. Y = total Death Star sites where opponent has no presence. Z = total sites at Yavin 4.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1, the current text (version 2 of 2). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-00-Commence_Primary_Ignition-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 10 November 2026); the release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text (see [[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Commence Primary Ignition (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]): Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet, official text as of 18 June 2010<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010, first printing not found). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “If Death Star orbits Alderaan (and [Virtual Block 7] Central Core on table), deploy on Death Star and fire Superlaser at Alderaan; it is 'blown away.' Once during your control phase, if Death Star orbiting a planet (except a Rebel Base) without related sites, may fire Superlaser at planet (regardless of Objective restrictions) as follows: Draw destiny. Add 2 if you control that system. If destiny + Y - Z > 8, target is 'blown away' and opponent loses 4 Force from Life Force. Y = total Death Star sites where opponent has no presence. Z = total sites at Yavin 4.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-00-Commence_Primary_Ignition.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-commenceprimaryignition-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (Dark Side p. 34)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> reprints it character for character: a stale reprint, not a new version, and it does not make this text current again.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, Virtual Block 7 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1271_18">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock7Type (Virtual Block 7 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “If Death Star orbits Alderaan (and [Virtual Block 7] Central Core on table), deploy on Death Star and fire Superlaser at Alderaan; it is 'blown away.' Once during your control phase, if Death Star orbiting a planet (except a Rebel Base) without related sites, may fire Superlaser at planet (regardless of Objective restrictions) as follows: Draw destiny. Add 2 if you control that system. If (destiny + Y - Z) > 8, target is 'blown away' and opponent loses 4 Force from Life Force. Y = total Death Star sites where opponent has no presence. Z = total sites at Yavin 4.” '''What changed:''' Parentheses are added around “destiny + Y - Z” (“If destiny + Y - Z > 8” becomes “If (destiny + Y - Z) > 8”). The same wording is already in the Players Committee's Holotable card data of 1 August 2010<ref name="cdf-1271_18">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/d14e714/db/darkside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 1 August 2010] (Players Committee data, copy on GitHub). Card data is dating evidence only, not a card document.</ref>. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes.
